text:
Type: faux sheepskin rug
Use: softening a floor, chair or bench; living room, bedroom, reading nook
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, bohemian
Materials: long soft faux fur pile, hide-shaped backing
Colors: creamy white
Shape: organic sheepskin outline with rounded lobes, long fluffy fur, small and soft, light visual weight
Feel: cosy, soft, warm, hygge
Goes with: light wood, white or grey walls, wool throws, black accents; Scandinavian, Japandi or bohemian bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: TEJN
product.description: The rug is super soft, warm and cosy. Ideal on the floor or draped across your favourite armchair.
